notes.title: HUNTING UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hunting is now available in Farmington County! Buy a hunting license at the Sporting Goods store. Then head over to Wodanaz forest directly across your farm. Watch out for animal footsteps to see where they may be. However, while you're hunting, you may be hunted too, so watch your back!

This update not only adds animals, but opens the way for more dynamic and action oriented content. 

New features: 
- Hunting! Aim for the head for high damage
- Peaceful and Predator animals
- Each gun deals different damages
- Health system

notes.title: HUNTING UPDATE!
notes.notes: Hunting Update is now live! You can buy a hunting license at the Sporting Goods store in front of the Train Station. Then, you can access the Wodanaz forest directly across from your farm. Be sure to protect yourself against predator animals, too!

notes.title: Beer Brewing Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm proud to introduce a new feature, Beer Brewing! It is buildable in the building menu under Utility. You will need to grow Hops first, which is only harvestable during fall unless you plant them in a greenhouse. 

I've also fixed some reported bugs including cantaloupe prices, grapes growth rates, and an autosaving issue involving slot 1. 

By the way, I have mapped out a new course for Farmington County and I think it would be really enjoyable if the game focused more on the production and expansion of the farm. For my next update I'm planning to add plank making to refine your harvested timber, expanded tree growing mechanics so you can have sustainable timber harvests, and letting the worker AI's load breweries, winemakers and plank making machines with their appropriate inputs. 

Thank you to everyone for the support!

notes.title: Minimap now Live!

Thank you to everyone playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: AI Employees Update!
notes.notes:
It's HERE! You can now hire AI employees to help around the farm. 

Currently they can Harvest crops by hand, and store goods into designated storage zones that you can build, under the new Build > AI category in the Building menu. They can be found near the Farm Store. The available workers will change every day.  

It took a while to do this update because it is such a major addition to the backend engine of the game. The new Workers react to their environment dynamically through an improved AI pathfinding and navigation system. They will automatically find which goods they can store and which crops are ready for harvesting. 

You pay them $40 a day to work full time in the farm. They will work from 8am-6pm every day. You can talk to them like any other NPC and you can tell them to follow you, or fire them. Harvesting and Hauling uses up their stamina, so you'd want to build comfort furniture like chairs and coffee stations so they can take energizing breaks.

To have them store goods automatically, go to the Building menu > AI category, then choose between the storage shelves available. Then, just carry whatever goods you want (tools not included) and either press the Interact or Action button while highlighting the storage zone, to set whatever you're carrying as the Type of goods that will be put into the zone.

I feel like this update really adds a lot to the game in different avenues. Spouses, expanded NPC interactions, stuff like that. However, in the near future, the new AI system will go well in hand with my plans to implement a more in-depth economic system, a more 'tycoon' type gameplay. Of course, the player will be able to choose between what playstyle they want. They can still have a small farm, or they can decide to grow it massively to compete with the big boys (or girls). AI workers will go a long way towards this goal. 

In the near future I will be adding more functionality to the AI workers - foremost of these will be being able to automatically load goods into processors, like the Fuel Refiner and the Wine Maker. You will be able to have a fully automated fuel refinery or winery, in addition to a few other business ventures I'm planning to put in with the planned Tycoon update. They will also have more traits and characteristics like different working speeds, motivation, happiness, and other factors like that.

Anyway, thank you all for supporting the game and I hope you enjoy this new update. Please report any bugs you notice and share any suggestions you may have. Thanks again!

notes.title: The Seasons and Weather Update!!
notes.notes:
It's here! The new Seasons and Weather update adds 3 new seasons with their own challenges. Greenhouses have also made their way into the game, allowing you to grow  and harvest your favorite crop all year round. Plus, 4 new crops! Artichokes, Grass, Wheat, and Pumpkins. Not to brag too much but I think the new farming and growing system for Farmington County makes it one of the most detailed and satisfying among popular farming games at the moment. Every plant has their own growing speed, health, drought tolerance, pest tolerance, and time before fruiting.  I hope everyone enjoys the new update!

Changes: 
- 4 new crops!
- Plants can now be harvested by hand multiple times and not be 'destroyed' as long as they are pest-free and healthy
- Harvester vehicles still destroy plants after harvesting but you get 2x the crops from these plants.
- Months are now changed into Seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter. 
- Crops will now die due to old age, pests, or not being watered. 
- 3 Greenhouse sizes! Small greenhouses can be constructed through the player's build menu (Utility section) and the Medium and Large greenhouses can be constructed using the Constructor vehicle (Misc section)
- Improved smoothness while riding vehicles
- Rain will water plants for you
- And many, many more!!!

notes.title: Beekeeping!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35908384/c8ba076e8692044f08e70e2a24c9b6f258a124b5.png[/img]

Farmington County now has beekeeping! Build beehives to increase the growth rate of your crops through pollination. Buy the Beekeeping helmet at the Farm Store, under tools, to harvest the honey. 

I used a realistic model to simulate honey production - the more crops you have, the more honey you'll get. The more beehives you have, the more your crops will be pollinated. Beehives divide the amount of pollen in the farm between themselves. 

In this Update I also coded in some framework for a weather and seasons system; rain, fog, clouds, etc. It won't be visible in this update yet but soon it will be!

For the next update I'm planning something big - either weather and/or working on the NPCs to make them feel more fully fleshed out individuals. Stay tuned and thank you for supporting Farmington County! Please don't forget to add Tags to the game in the store page so other people can see it. Thank you again!

notes.title: Guns, Shooting, Inventory, and 300% Bigger Map, Finally here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35908384/19a1fc30386d00874ba81f0b254865d2633b758f.png[/img]

This is a BIG update, not just the readily visible new features but I added a lot of backend systems that will allow me to add more things and gameplay elements to Farmington County. This update is very foundational; I believe there is now a solid base to the game that will allow me to add bigger and better things, faster. Be sure to check out the [b]Tutorial [/b]section again to see how the new features work. 

Anyway, what's in this update? Let's start with the major stuff: 

[b]GUNS! And Shooting! And Targets![/b] - I designed a shooting system from scratch. It uses actual physics-based bullets, and all guns have different characteristics. I am planning to add more guns in the future, right now there are 4 types - a pistol, a shotgun, a semi auto rifle, and a fully automatic rifle. You can buy these guns at the Gun Shop, next to the Gas Station.
I have also included 3 different, specifically designed targets to practice your shooting on. Because the bullets are physics-based, the targets all move and behave realistically. They're a good way to practice your top-down shooting skills. You can build these on your farm so you can have your own firing range. They can be found under the building menu, in the Utilities category. 

There is also a ready-to-use shooting range next to the new Gun Store.

[i]A note about the guns:[/i] from the beginning I envisioned Farmington County to not only be a farming game but a full on, grown up country lifestyle simulation. Your Farm, and Farming, will always be the focus of Farmington County but I aim to give the players a lot of things they can do that is still keeping with the theme and the overall feel of the game.

I love making this game and I want it to reach its full potential and in my head (and notes) I've already mapped out the road this game's development is going to take. I'm willing to take huge risks with the game design, and I've thought things through and it will just feel a lot more authentic if there are more 'grown up' elements to the game, like crime, law enforcement, and adult relationships, just as there are in real life. Don't worry though, it won't be fantasy farming, you won't engage in bloodbaths every time you go out of the farmhouse, you won't be shooting dragons out of the sky. Everything will be keeping in theme with the rest of the game and combat will always be organically optional. 

Back to the update - the [b]New Inventory System[/b]! You can now carry around multiple tools on your person. Does he put it his pockets? In his pants? Under his shirt? Who knows, but again I tried my best to maintain the current feel of the game where storage, transportation and organization is still key. The Inventory system is based on item sizes, some will take more space in your inventory and some will be smaller. Practically, this means you'll be able to carry around 1-2 tools on your person plus a seed bag. You'll still need your vehicles to do large scale, actual hauling. 

[b]Bigger Map! More Exploration! [/b] - so the map is almost 3x bigger which is a big reason as to why the update took so long - a lot of it was optimization. It's mostly sparse right now but I have a very good idea of what's going to be in those new areas. I also hand painted some new trees, and they look so much more natural and lush now. For the next update I will also change the graphics for the crops and weeds so they all look bushier and more natural.

There's also a bunch of other things: Controls are changed a little, I did a ton of optimization (3x bigger map and more stuff under the hood at basically the same performance level).

Thank you to everyone for the support! I have great plans for Farmington County. Up next will be Farming-focused content, I will announce what exactly the next update will be in the Community discussion. Thanks again!

notes.title: New, Realistic Vehicle Physics and Vehicle Customization
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35908384/252bac9184d52136c06edcc2b9dff31697127b59.png[/img]

It's here! The new Vehicle Physics System for Farmington County has arrived. All vehicles now have their own physical characteristics such as suspension, tire friction, weight distribution, more realistic mass, top speed, acceleration, and braking.

Alongside this huge update is another HUGE update: Vehicle Customization options! The Mechanic Station can be found in the player's build menu under the Utility section. You can change the specific colors of any vehicle. You can upgrade the engine characteristics like acceleration, top speed and braking, change the suspension system, and choose tires for all of your vehicles.

Finally, there are two new, high performance luxury offroad vehicles for sale at Dixon's Auto shop: The Aufgeld G450 and the Aufgeld G560. Check them out! These beasts haul ***!

Future updates will feature new farming vehicles as well as new, fun vehicle related gameplay such as racing, offroading, and cargo delivery services, along with new buildable objects for your farm. 

Thanks to everyone who have supported the game!

notes.title: Optimization, Bug fixes, and Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here's another update! Thank you to everyone who supported the game and provided feedback. I've been squashing a lot of the bugs with the help of your reports. Here's what's new in this update:

- Optimization (especially for after you sleep on the first night after loading a game)
- You can now see Plot Borders when building sprinklers, for more precise placement
- You can now sell fuel at the train station
- Fuel is now more expensive but fuel consumption has been adjusted for all vehicles
- Fuel prices now change weekly
- You can see Fuel prices on the gas station sign
- Fuel Refiners now make fuel even while you're sleeping. They're also 300% more efficient
- Fixed tree and weed growth levels
- Fixed roofs not appearing when roofed vehicles are parked in structures
- Tohoya Dynamo ramp position fixed
- Initial mouse position changed
- Animals now eat, get hungry, wander around, and do the bow-chicka-bow-wow with each other
- Dogs now don't sink under their beds and food bowls
- Dog CV-01 is now Dog Constructor

I'm very excited about the things I have planned for this game! The bugs are being squashed and soon I will be able to focus on adding new gameplay things. Developing is going at a fast and steady pace in my opinion, and the construction boom in Farmington County continues!
